summary: Examples of import_playbook: importing after a play, setting vars on the import, importing from a collection, and the invalid case of using it inside tasks.
questions: How do I pass variables to an imported playbook?
How do I import a playbook from a collection?
Why does import_playbook fail inside my tasks?

answer_card.title: import_playbook examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - debug: {msg: play1}

- ansible.builtin.import_playbook: otherplays.yml
  vars:
    service: httpd

- ansible.builtin.import_playbook: my_namespace.my_collection.my_playbook
```
Using it under `tasks:` fails; it must be at play level.
